doc: Rows pinned at the extremes: thr = -10 (overcast, streak <= -1 so the coverage is exactly 1) and +10 (clear) give a zero difference and return exactly the floor 0.05; interior thresholds give a larger value. No subtexel, scalar streak -3.0, float32 fields. Arguments: s, fine, thr, streak and subtexel are the inputs of that name when listed; an unlisted streak (default 0.0) is the scalar in params, an unlisted subtexel is None; prm holds the GenParams fields compose reads plus sensitivity_step. The floor 0.05 is a literal of the source. Measured: promoting the float32 inputs to float64 changes the output by at most 2.5e-9; one-ulp nudges of every float input and parameter change it by at most 1.1e-7 (worst of 6 random trials); the tolerance is 26x the larger of the two spreads.
